title: The Hall in Sirik

mood.label: Heavy going, war reached a wedding
mood.summary: A widening Gulf war reached a wedding hall in Sirik, and Iran answered across three neighbours; Kyiv burned a sixth night, floods held above a thousand, eurozone prices hit a three-year high. Against it: Uganda declared Ebola-free, cleaner London air growing children's lungs.

lines: The hall in Sirik dressed for dancing,
five gone now, and one a child.
By dark it was Bahrain and Jordan -
answer for answer down the line.
Somewhere a child in cleaner air
Hold the thin line. Hold it.
Sixth night on Kyiv, still counting;
six of the twelve just kept the rails.
